CORE-LOOSE.behaviour_notes:
ARCHITECTURE.md no longer recommends `--test-force-exit`. The Conventions section now says to run one file with `node --test path/to/x.test.js` and gives the reason, the same way CLAUDE.md and run-tests.mjs do.

Pure moves. The old path of each file is now a one-line `module.exports = require(newPath)` shim with a comment. Tests moved along with their files, and their relative specifiers were recomputed:
- azureServiceCosts and webSearchInferenceResolver went to core/llm/
- n8nWorkflowConverter went to core/kb/
- umamiClient and its test went to core/cms/
- automationErrors went to core/automationRunner/
- serviceAuth went to core/http/
- projectFeed, projectFeed.runs and their tests went to core/projectContent/
- concurrencyUtil went to server/utils/. It has no dependencies, so it counts as platform under ARCHITECTURE.md.

Importers keep the old paths, so string-keyed stubs and require.cache keys keep matching. There are two exceptions. The shims for azureServiceCosts and webSearchInferenceResolver landed inside the big server import cycle, which pushed scc from 569 to 571. To fix that, their 7 importers now require the new path directly. One test was adapted: webSearchInference.validation.test.js matches the parent filename and the configStore require string.

Left at the flat level on purpose, and documented in ARCHITECTURE.md:
- The entry points: aiAgent, aiTaskRunner, automationRunner (plus its partial testkit), executionEngine, mcpManager (plus mcpChildEnv), projectEventBus and runEventBus.
- releaseNotesFormat and releaseNotesDrafter. scripts/release-notes/draft.js and build-push-ghcr.yml load server/core/releaseNotesFormat.js by that path, and both are outside this lane.

The layout section of ARCHITECTURE.md now has a shim table and a note on the scc trap, and its folder list was updated. CLAUDE.md needed no change, since the paths it names (aiAgent, mcpManager) did not move.

I staged the three test-file renames with `git add`, nothing else. This was needed because lint:source-text reads `git ls-files` and crashed with ENOENT on a tracked file that had been deleted but not staged. No commit, stash, checkout or reset.

2. Should the release-notes pair move too? That means changing scripts/release-notes/draft.js and build-push-ghcr.yml in the same change.
3. Removing the shims later is a separate step: rewrite each importer and its stub keys to the new path, then delete the shim.

check-fast: `node scripts/check-fast.mjs --list --slack` (also `--slack` alone, and it works with `--only`) runs the non-.sh lint:* gates. It prints a table of gate / scope / measured / budget / slack, then the count of ratchets with slack and which ones an `--update` would lower. It exits 1 if a gate fails. The new exported `parseSlack()` reads the ✅/➖/❌ verdict line every ratchet prints: ceilings ("budget of/is N"), floors ("floor of/is N", where slack = measured − floor) and "at budget/at the floor". When the verdict line carries no number (source-text), it takes the last number printed before that line. Three new tests cover the parser across all verdict kinds, the CLI table, and the exit code on failure. CLAUDE.md: one line added to the check:fast bullet.
